final_message:
The change is likely to fail.

The storefront list filters hidden boxes only after pagination, so hidden records still consume page slots and the returned pagination metadata may include them. A page can therefore be incomplete or empty even when visible boxes exist on later pages. Filtering must happen in the facade/query before pagination, with counts based only on visible boxes.

The individual hidden-box lookup appears correctly mapped to return 404.

VERDICT: FAIL
CONFIDENCE: 88
